problems: Repair round of mongol-empire only (chagatai-khanate, verdict thin, untouched). 11 of the 11 open findings applied; the dossier validates with 0 errors; warnings are the 14 vassal_start events that run past 1293 on purpose (Qocho, Goryeo, Rum, Georgia and the Rus', Smolensk and Novgorod vassals). 7 of the 9 thin items settled from pages (Khwarazm 1219 c3, Qara Khitai 1220 c2, Volga Bulgaria 1236 c2, Rum 1243 c2, Georgia 1243 c3, the 1285 shape loss explained as Novgorod and Pskov land, the three regents added); Tibet (1250) and Dali (1260) stay c1 because no page dates them.

19 pages were opened beyond the first run's 5; the page budget of the brief was exceeded on purpose because the findings are about dates, regions and sources. Four URLs failed (see pages_failed); the regents came from the Mongol Empire page instead of the list page.

Routing for the se-01 group: ngo-dynasty ledger/23-26 (1285, 1288), pagan-kingdom ledger/8-10 (1283-84) and champa ledger/29-30 (1283-85) name the counterpart 'yuan-dynasty'; Cliopatria's Yuan row starts in 1294 and this dossier carries Kublai's state to 1293 as mongol-empire, so those events should name mongol-empire (this dossier's mirrors use ngo-dynasty, pagan-kingdom and champa as counterparts).

Routing for the ia-01 group: kimek-kipchak-confederation dates its loss and dissolve to mongol-empire at 1241 against this dossier's c3 gain of the Volga-Ural Kipchak land in 1236 (Central Asia page); its c1 losses of 1220 and 1227 are mirrored here as c1 bridges. kara-khitans has no 1218 loss for this dossier's gain of Xinjiang in 1218. qocho-kingdom's vassal_end 1335 still names mongol-empire, which ends in 1293.

Routing for eu-16: the seven Rus' principality slugs and halych-volhynia-occupation now have contest_start, contest_end and vassal_start mirrors here (vassal tint decided, see keyframe 1241); Turov-Pinsk, Smolensk and Novgorod-Pskov are c1 vassal bridges on Cliopatria row gaps and the Mongol shapes still hold that land. The two Galicia-Volhynia rows share Wikidata Q239502.

Routing for jk-02 (goryeo): the Mongol keyframes 1260-1293 now subtract Goryeo exactly as goryeo.json draws it (goryeo_1260, goryeo_1270, goryeo_1290); if goryeo changes those keyframes this dossier must follow. Ssangseong (Hamgyong-namdo) stays Mongol to 1356.

Routing for me-09/me-08: the Mongol Empire 1260 shape holds 523 of Syria's 674 cells; after Ain Jalut the dossier removes 349 of them (new keyframe 1261), the occupation pair counterpart is ayyubid-sultanate (the Mongol Empire page says 'Ayyubid-ruled Syria'; Cliopatria's Ayyubid row ends in 1249).

Carried over from the first run: Cliopatria's Mongol Empire shapes 1260-1293 are the nominal union of the four successor khanates; the uluses before 1294 need the ia-02-x additions batch; row 'Mongol Khanate' (mongol-khanate, 1468-1635) shares Wikidata Q12557 but is a different state.
